decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's modular processing knowledge and has demonstrated quantified savings, so its absorptive capacity supports ongoing refinement and retention.
Because mobile slow-speed shredders are close to the firm's existing shredder expertise, the firm can assimilate early market feedback and improve the product rather than drop it.
With a specific customer success and alignment to the established MMAK concept, the firm has the related knowledge to learn from results and keep the product.
As a recent extension of the firm's slow-speed shredder line, it is close to existing knowledge, enabling the firm to interpret early results and make improvements, so dropping is unlikely.
